body.x: Addeleco will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 andwill display its portable 2.4Ghz digital wireless microphone system in CESstartup zone Eureka Park MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT with the support from ChangwonIndustry Promotion Agency.

Addeleco’s portable 2.4GHz digital wirelessmicrophone system consists of a microphone (transmitter) and a body (speakers,receiver, amplifier). There are many types of portable wireless microphones onthe market, and they are sold in various sizes ranging from small (less than1kg, 250 to 400 thousand won), medium (2kg to 4kg, 600 to 800 thousand won),and large (more than 4kg, more than 800 won).

The official said, "Most of the users of small wireless microphones are those who mainly teach or lead people, such as elementary, middle and high school teachers, lecturers, leaders, and military assistants. They were using products that were easy to use and light to carry, but they were found to be uncomfortable because they were not loud and clear. To address this inconvenience, the first step was to increase the size of the product (around 200% compared to the previous product), to equip the 4-inch 50-watt speaker rarely used in the compact portable microphone to improve resonation, thus making the sound space rich and clear."

He continued, “To reduce the weight further as the size increases, the neodymium speaker were used to reduce the part that was the heaviest (300% reduction compared to other speakers), making it easier to carry around with just 1.2kg of the weight.” He also said, “By using our communication module made by the technology patented in US and Korea boasting 100% digital 2.4GHz sound, it plays CD quality covering the frequency of 20Hz to 20kHz, bringing highest quality sound to the listeners. We also made Korea's only portable digital wireless microphone system differentiated from the existing products by improving performance and minimizing weight with the advanced technology and the best technology of various parts."

The transmitter by Addeleco transmitters (microphones) comes in two types, handheld and beltpack microphones, and use external batteries that can be replaced. The main body has a stereo amplifier, a receiver, a speaker, and a lithium ion battery. It is also small, but expandable with ordinary PA speakers (100-300 watts). The transmission/reception range is about 20m, and the main body use time is about 10 - 15 hours.

Addeleco focuses on the development and production of portable (portable) types of 2.4Ghz digital microphones. They are being used by a wide range of people, from teachers, coaches, companies, academies, public institutions, training insitutions, and religious and recreation places. The demand is expected to be high because it is easy to carry and boasts stylish design and excellent performance.

AVING NEWS, the media that has made themost promotion of Korean companies, has set up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT in CES2020 Startup Zone EUREKA PARK as the project to help Korean startups to enterthe global market, and will introduce the major Korean startups to the world.

By using the strengths of CES, AVING NEWS plans to inform investors, buyers and media Korea’s promising startups through various programs such as strategic consulting, PR marketing, and networking parties.

MIK Zone is hosted by Next Generation Convergence Contents Industry Association, AVING NEWS, and MD Insight, and organized by Bluefoot. It is participated by Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, Incheon Techno Park Startup Support Center, Gwangju University Startup Support Group, and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group.
